name: Dim Necrotic Stone
summary: Dim Necrotic Stones are shadowy relics recovered from the corpses of Scourge shock troops invading the outskirts of major capital cities. Infused with faint unholy energies, they serve as proof of martial victory and aid the Argent Dawn in studying the undead vanguard.

sections.title: Trophies of the Scourge Encampments
sections.body: When necropolises appear in the skies and the Lich King sends his forces to assault the outskirts of cities like Stormwind and Orgrimmar, Dim Necrotic Stones are found carried by the invading skeletal troopers, spectral spirits, and aberrations. The stones thrum with remnants of the unnatural magic tethering the undead to their masters. The Argent Dawn collects these stones from volunteers willing to thin out the Scourge forces, treating them as material evidence that invading encampments have been disrupted.

sections.title: Ties to Unholy Magic
sections.body: These stones are closely linked to the glowing runic circles that the Scourge erects around their landing points. Argent Dawn investigators believe the stones and their corresponding circles channel unholy energies to maintain contact between front-line strike teams and the dread minds commanding them from above. Studying the stones assists defenders in piecing together the magical means by which the Scourge coordinates its sudden strikes across Azeroth.

faq.q: Where do Dim Necrotic Stones come from?
aliases: how to get dim necrotic stones
faq.answer: They are scavenged directly from Scourge foot soldiers, such as skeletal troopers and spectral apparitions, attacking near the outskirts of major faction capitals during Scourge assaults.

faq.q: Why does the Argent Dawn want these stones?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn seeks concrete proof that defenders are repelling the undead vanguard and uses the artifacts to study the unholy energy and communications binding the invaders together.

faq.q: What connection do these stones have to the glowing runic circles?
faq.answer: Both the stones and the runic circles radiate the same necrotic power. The Argent Dawn suspects the runic circles serve as sinister communication conduits, drawing on unholy energy similar to the residue within the stones.

faq.q: Can these stones be found outside of Stormwind?
faq.answer: Yes. Scourge forces push against cities across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, including Ironforge, Darnassus, Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, carrying these stones wherever they establish camps.

angles.text: Alliance recruits outside Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus gather these stones to protect their capitals and aid the Argent Dawn's defensive efforts against the sudden undead onslaught.
Warriors of the Horde recover these trophies from fallen Scourge troops besieging Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the ruins above Undercity to demonstrate their martial resolve.
